questions.q: When has a friend earned your trust, and what did they do to earn it?
questions.answer: One example: "A friend who kept my secret and showed up when they said they would." They kept giving me reasons, and the more I knew them, the more I trusted them.

questions.q: Is the faith you have really your own, or is it borrowed from your parents?
questions.answer: One honest answer: "A lot of it is borrowed from my parents. I want to look at the evidence myself, like the signs John wrote down so we may believe."

questions.q: Why do you think Jesus kept his wounds and showed them to Thomas?
questions.answer: Maybe to give Thomas one more reason to believe: proof that it was really him, and that he had done exactly what he said he would do.
